We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts describe theft of copper wire from transformers, i.e., stealing property. This is theft (盗窃). Also possibly "破坏电力设施罪"? In Chinese criminal law, destroying electric power facilities causing loss may be "破坏电力设施罪" (damage to electric power facilities). However the main conduct is theft of copper wire, i.e., theft of property. The act of dismantling transformers could be considered "破坏电力设施罪" if it endangers safety. But the description: they dismantled transformers installed in fields, took copper wire. The loss includes transformer damage. The crime likely is theft (盗窃). Also possibly "抢劫"? No. So answer: 盗窃.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
